support_kind: direct ligand binding and receptor-complex activation

support_kind: direct steroid receptor binding and function

audit_notes: Exact androstenedione-AR evidence does not validate the submitted composite.

support_kind: direct steroid receptor binding and function

support_kind: direct ligand-receptor binding and receptor-dependent function

support_kind: direct ANXA1-FPR2 binding;alternate FPR2 agonist context

support_kind: direct peptide-receptor activation and receptor-dependent function

support_kind: direct apolipoprotein binding and receptor-dependent uptake

audit_notes: Exact ApoB-TREM2 evidence is present; TYROBP is complex context.

support_kind: direct apolipoprotein binding and receptor-dependent phagocytic function

support_kind: direct protein binding and receptor-dependent trafficking

support_kind: direct growth-factor receptor activation

support_kind: direct chemokine binding

support_kind: direct chemokine binding and scavenging function

support_kind: direct chemokine binding and receptor-dependent migration
evidence_summary: CCL5/RANTES drives mast-cell migration blocked by CCR1 antibodies, and CCR1 binding/activation studies test CCL5 among its ligands.

support_kind: direct chemokine binding and receptor activation

support_kind: direct chemokine binding and scavenging function

support_kind: direct chemokine binding and receptor activation

support_kind: direct chemokine binding and receptor-dependent uptake/function

support_kind: direct chemokine binding
